scripts.build: bun run --filter @base-ui-svelte/styles build && bun run --filter base-ui-svelte build
scripts.check: bun run --filter @base-ui-svelte/styles check && bun run --filter base-ui-svelte check && bun run --filter docs check
scripts.publint: bun run --filter base-ui-svelte publint && bun run --filter @base-ui-svelte/styles publint
scripts.release:pack: bun run build && bun run publint && npm pack --cwd packages/svelte && npm pack --cwd packages/styles
